title: 第26章 路途第27章 巨蜘蛛
slug: 异界冒险从组建冒险团开始
content_zh:
铁拳冒险团四人一声不吭地离开，临走前并没有放什么狠话，但沃尔清楚，双方梁子已经结下，如果有机会，这些人肯定会想办法把场子找回来。
当然，如果没有意外，这些人应该也不会特意再来找麻烦，毕竟大家都是为了赚钱，不是出来争勇斗狠的。
况且这一次都没有见血，只能算是小摩擦，这在冒险者中很常见。
随着铁拳冒险团离开，周围看热闹的冒险者们纷纷摇头叹息，这几个人也太怂了，怎么不敢上去干一下呢？随后还是该干嘛干嘛，屋内很快恢复了正常。
沃尔和扎木合了解了事情的经过后，鼓励了几句，肯定了他的做法，这才重新掏出任务单查看。
【驱逐任务】
〖目标：巨蜘蛛，初步判断为腐毒巨蜘蛛，数量3-5只〗
〖两个村民在外出干农活时失踪，有人目睹黑色巨型蜘蛛在森林外围结网〗
〖奖金：400铜币，按实际情况追加〗
“腐毒巨蜘蛛？应该不难对付，蜘蛛腺体还挺值钱的，不错。”
沃尔回想起这种怪物的资料，这种蜘蛛成年后腿展开能超过3米，拥有厚重的甲壳，通常以家庭为单位结网捕猎。
虽然外貌恐怖，在前世能直接吓死一群人，但危险程度也就一般，比哥布林高不太多，只要小心别被蜘蛛网缠上就行。
直接去柜台签订契约后，一个穿着朴素的中年男人有些局促地上前：
“勇者阁下，抱歉打扰，我就是那个农庄的农民，能不能问一下，你们什么时候出发……”
沃尔看了一下地图，路程比上一次要近一些，如果现在收拾东西出发，在天黑前应该能够抵达。
他用缓和的语气说道：“这位先生，你应该不是一个人来镇上的吧，今天要赶回去吗？”
这个世界敢单独出行的人很多，但应该不包括眼前的村民。
见这位穿着厚重板甲的冒险者表现得像是个文明人，中年男人放松了一些，但还是老实回答道：
“是的，勇者阁下，我的同伴们去街上贩卖货物去了，等太阳再向西一些，我们就会到城门汇合一起回去。”
沃尔理解对方的担忧，思索了一下，说道：“我们等会就会出发前往你们的农庄，如果需要，我们可以一起过去。”

信息上说巨蜘蛛已经导致两人失踪，大概是被蜘蛛毒液变成美味汤点了，害怕和催促很正常。
得知冒险者今天就会出发消灭怪物，中年男人很是高兴，激动地连连鞠躬道谢。
约定好过一会去下城门口汇合，沃尔带着众人开始整理物资。
这一次大部分东西都提前备好，两天前，沃尔花费了五枚金币购买了一匹强壮的青年挽马，以及一台带车棚的木轮板车，专门为部队拉运物资。
不过面对巨蜘蛛，还需要一些特别的物品，腐蚀毒特效解药，用处不用说，强效酒和动物油膏，可以解除蜘蛛丝的粘黏。
以及一大袋干沙粉，用于探路，发现那些透明的蜘蛛丝，课本上说用白面粉效果更好，但那过于奢侈。
任务还没开始，就已经花费了近100铜币，沃尔反而感觉内心安定。
作为穿越者，沃尔其实经常有实力焦虑，没有安全感，提前做好准备能让他自己感到安心。
嘎吱～嘎吱～
车轮轻快地碾过压实的路面，被取名为萝卜的黑色挽马看起来状态很不错，队伍行进的速度比上一次快了不少。
content_en:
The four members of the Iron Fist Adventure Group left without saying a word. They didn't say any harsh words before leaving, but Wall knew that the feud between the two parties had been forged. If given the chance, these people would definitely find a way to get the situation back.
Of course, if there are no accidents, these people should not go out of their way to cause trouble again. After all, everyone is here to make money, not to fight bravely.
Moreover, there was no blood this time, it could only be regarded as a minor friction, which is very common among adventurers.
As the Iron Fist adventure group left, the adventurers watching the excitement shook their heads and sighed. These people were too timid, why didn't they dare to go up and do it? Afterwards, we continued to do whatever we had to do, and the room quickly returned to normal.
After Wall and Zamuhe understood what happened, they encouraged him a few words and affirmed his approach, and then took out the task list to check again.
【Expulsion Mission】
〖Target: Giant spider, initially judged to be poisonous giant spider, number 3-5〗
〖Two villagers disappeared while going out to do farm work, and someone saw a giant black spider spinning a web outside the forest〗
〖Bonus: 400 copper coins, additional according to actual situation〗
"The poisonous giant spider? It shouldn't be difficult to deal with. The spider glands are quite valuable, not bad."
Wall recalled the information about this monster. This spider can spread its hind legs more than 3 meters as an adult, has a thick carapace, and usually builds webs in family units to hunt.
Although it looks terrifying and could scare a group of people to death in its previous life, its danger level is only average, not much higher than that of goblins. Just be careful not to get entangled in spider webs.
After going directly to the counter to sign the contract, a plainly dressed middle-aged man stepped forward awkwardly:
"Your Excellency Brave, I'm sorry to bother you. I'm a farmer from that farm. Can I ask when you will set off..."
Wall looked at the map and found that the distance was shorter than last time. If he packed up his things and set off now, he should be able to arrive before dark.
He said in a gentle tone: "Sir, you probably didn't come to town alone, right? Do you want to rush back today?"
There are many people in this world who dare to travel alone, but that probably does not include the villagers in front of them.
Seeing that the adventurer wearing heavy plate armor acted like a civilized man, the middle-aged man relaxed a little, but still answered honestly:
"Yes, Your Majesty the Brave, my companions have gone to sell goods on the street. When the sun goes farther west, we will meet at the city gate and go back together."
Wall understood the other party's concerns, thought for a moment, and said, "We will leave for your farm in a moment. If necessary, we can go there together."
The information said that a giant spider had caused two people to disappear. They were probably turned into delicious soup points by the spider venom. It was normal to be afraid and urged.
Knowing that the adventurers would set out to eliminate monsters today, the middle-aged man was very happy and bowed excitedly to thank him.
After agreeing to meet at the gate of the lower city in a while, Wall led everyone to start sorting out supplies.
This time, most of the things were prepared in advance. Two days ago, Wall spent five gold coins to buy a strong young draft horse and a wooden wheeled cart with a shed, specifically to transport supplies for the troops.
However, when facing giant spiders, some special items are needed. Special antidote to corrosive poison. Needless to say, powerful wine and animal ointment can remove the stickiness of spider silk.
And a large bag of dry sand powder, used to explore the path and find those transparent spider silks. The textbook said that using white flour would be better, but that was too extravagant.
Nearly 100 copper coins had been spent before the mission even started, and Wall felt at peace.
As a time traveler, Wall actually often has strength anxiety and insecurity. Being prepared in advance can make him feel at ease.
Crunch~crunch~
The wheels rolled briskly across the compacted road. The black draft horse named Carrot looked to be in good condition, and the team was moving much faster than last time.
